grading_words: Graded as one group, exactly as the public record carries them: 291 calls that passed every check across the 15 board sessions on record. At 21 days, not yet graded: the first grades are due after the close on Monday, November 23, 2026. No single idea carries a grade of its own; the grade belongs to the group. The board session this page's ideas come from, Friday, November 13, 2026, is not in The Record yet; it joins the graded record when The Record next refreshes.
